lines: I close my eyes and feel it.
The first warmth.
It was shut away.
Deep within my chest.
I won't lose to anyone.
With your courage.
It slowly melts away.
Protect it with that hand.
The sins I made, the unforgivable past, the one I love.
Carrying loneliness, I walk any road.
As long as I have life.
Even if the world ends tomorrow.
If you stay by my side.
Because I’ll remember you over and over.
I gently hold your hand.
It stretches on without end.
Along this journey.
On anxious nights, tears that flow.
I place my hand on my cheek.
With your courage.
I light my heart.
Grasp it with that hand.
Unseen dreams, smiles, even peace.
A strong yearning I devote to what I must protect, no matter when.
We can layer them together.
Even if not everything is purely right.
I will go with you forever.
A miracle living guided by that hand.
I carve it into my heart.
Protect it with that hand.
The sins I made, the unforgivable past, the one I love.
Carrying loneliness, I walk any road.
As long as I have life.

If you stay by my side.
Because I’ll remember you over and over.
I gently hold your hand.
